meta.author: Melusina + overnight loop
meta.purpose: Seed catalog for the recursive overnight TD effect-expansion loop. Each cron run adds ONE effect from this pool, verifies it live, and logs evidence to the ledger.

effects.name: Audio-reactive resonance rings
effects.description: Concentric rings radiating from the starfield center, radius and opacity driven by the 5-band audio analyzers (band1..band5) in /project1/audio.
effects.recipe_hint: Create a rings COMP under /project1; drive radius/opacity from audio band CHOPs; composite over starfield before spoutout1.

effects.name: Toon volumetric glow
effects.description: AAA toon-style volumetric glow (bloom with stepped/hard falloff) over the composite, tuned to the warm-violet palette.
effects.recipe_hint: glowTOP or bloomTOP with high-threshold stepped falloff; fold into postfx/comp_stars.

effects.name: Hand-openness bloom gate
effects.description: Hand openness (hand/0/open) drives bloom intensity: open hand = wide ethereal bloom, fist = tight/no bloom.
effects.recipe_hint: map hand/0/open to glow/bloom amount par via expression; do not touch starfield transform bindings.

effects.name: Wrist-X hue shift
effects.description: Wrist x-position sweeps a hue shift across the composite, tying hand movement to color (performed color).
effects.recipe_hint: hsvTOP or levelTOP hue par driven by hand/0/wrist1; palette-aware.

effects.name: Beat-pulse starburst
effects.description: Starburst/cross flare that pulses on the beat (from beat_pulse_* in the osc COMP), synced to the song tempo.
effects.recipe_hint: Use beat_pulse_* channels already present; drive flare scale/opacity.

effects.name: Spectral rain particles
effects.description: Particle rain whose speed/alpha map to spectral_analyzer output; ties the audio spectrum to motion.
effects.recipe_hint: particlesGPUCOMP; per-particle attribute from spectral analyzer CHOP.

effects.name: Chord-detector color wash
effects.description: chord_detector output drives a slowly-changing background color wash, so the harmony is visible as color.
effects.recipe_hint: Map chord label to a color ramp (palette.json tokens); feed a TOP background gradient.

effects.name: Pinch-to-delay echo
effects.description: Thumb-index distance drives audio delay time / echo feedback, an Imogen Heap-style live vocal/texture effect.
effects.recipe_hint: hand/0 thumb-index distance -> delay1CHOP or audio delay par; continuous gesture->sound.

effects.name: Two-finger harmony chord
effects.description: Two fingers held up triggers a harmony chord: adds a layered note/visual harmonic to the composite.
effects.recipe_hint: Gesture classifier (hand/0/open + finger distances) -> chord trigger -> visual + optional MIDI note.

effects.name: Wave arpeggio spiral
effects.description: Waving gesture runs an arpeggio spiral (rotating radial arcs), each wave advancing the arpeggio.
effects.recipe_hint: Wave detection -> arpeggio step counter -> rotating spiral COMP.

effects.name: Spout-in live composite
effects.description: Wire the Blender Spout input (syphonspoutinTOP) into the composite so the live Blender Eevee render is the scene layer.
effects.recipe_hint: syphonspoutinTOP sendername=Blender camera; composite under spoutout1.

effects.name: Grandmaster vignette + title
effects.description: Branded vignette and 'Grandmaster Melodia' title card using palette tokens, final polish before spoutout1.
effects.recipe_hint: vignetteTOP + textTOP; palette.json gold filigree + starlight.

effects.name: Infinity hyper-spiral (math orbit)
effects.description: INFINITY NIKKI-INSPIRED: a dense mathematical orbital spiral of nested rotating arcs (golden-ratio + Fibonacci spacing), infinitely-receding into the center. Complex, ornate, mathematical — the 'infinity' motif. Audio band2/3 drive rotation speed and scale breathing.
effects.recipe_hint: Topological/instanced radial arcs (circleTOP segments or point instances) arranged on a phi/Fibonacci spiral; rotate + scale-recede by audio bands; composite under postfx. Palette: golden_gilt + warm_lilac.

effects.name: CoPPL chromatic glitch (SOPHIE-style)
effects.description: CRAZY CoPPL EFFECT: harsh chromatic-aberration + glitch-displacement + scanline-dither RGB split that slams in on the beat. Ninajirachi/SOPHIE hyperpop energy — colorful, chaotic, crunchy.
effects.recipe_hint: rgbOffset/levelTOP RGB split + noise-driven displacement + quantized dither; beat-pulse to intensity. Palette: ether_mint + soft_rose contrast, overdriven.

effects.name: Infinity mirror room (recursive reflections)
effects.description: INFINITY NIKKI-INSPIRED: a recursive mirror-hall effect — the composite reflected into itself infinitely with depth fade, golden filigree edges. Gives the 'endless ornate palace' feel.
effects.recipe_hint: Feedback loop: compositeTOP feedbacking into itself via a delayed copy with shrink/rotate + opacity fade; gold edge overlay.

effects.name: CoPPL candy-glass distortion (Ninajirachi)
effects.description: CRAZY CoPPL EFFECT: hand-openness sweeps a candy-glass liquid distortion (warp/liquify) — the visual 'bends' like molten candy with the hand. Sonic-bright, plastic, hyperpop.
effects.recipe_hint: warpTOP/liquify with amplitude mapped to hand openness + high band; smooth but extreme range.

effects.name: Mathematical Rose curve mandala
effects.description: INFINITY NIKKI-INSPIRED: live-generated rose-curve (r = a·cos(kθ)) mandala whose petal count k animates through integers driven by the chord detector — each chord = a new petal symmetry.
effects.recipe_hint: circleTOP/pointSOP instanced along rose curve; k from chord_detector; palette warm_lilac/soft_rose; slowly rotating.

effects.name: CoPPL bloom detonation (SOPHIE kick)
effects.description: CRAZY CoPPL EFFECT: sub-bass 'kick' triggers a bloom detonation — a hard, saturated, white-hot core that blooms out violently then crunches down. Maximalist, the SOPHIE drop feel.
effects.recipe_hint: threshold+bloom with a hard envelope from band1; color clip to hot white->gold; fast attack, slower decay.
